Explanation:
The value of the house increased by 150%, so the value of the house is $80,000 + $150% of $80,000 = $80,000 + $120,000 = $200,000.
The profit is the value of the house minus the cost of the house, so the profit is $200,000 - $80,000 = $120,000.
However, Josh put in $50,000 in repairs, so the profit is $120,000 - $50,000 = $70,000.
